title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods

TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 

There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 

Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 

Data Analyst Role

We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 

This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 

Responsibilities 

  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 

Requirements 

  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 

Our Culture

We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 

We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.

Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.

Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.

English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.

What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.

Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).

Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation

What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes

Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding

Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Engenheiro de IA - Junior

  • Noções de embeddings vetoriais , LangChain ou integração com bancos vetoriais

title: Desenhista mecânico

Dê a sua contribuição para neutralizar o carbono em mercados como de nuclear, energia, infraestrutura, saneamento e meio ambiente.

Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!

O que oferecemos

  • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.

Como Desenhista Mecânico da área de Infraestrutura, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.

As suas principais responsabilidades

Quem somos

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

Saiba mais sobre a , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!

Como parte do Grupo ENGIE , com 96.000 colaboradores, você terá oportunidades de trilhar seu caminho profissional sempre moldando um mundo mais sustentável.

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.

We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.

Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  1. Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  2. Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  3. Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  4. Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  5. Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.

Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.

By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.

We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Analista de QA
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Mentorar e guiar Analistas de QA Júnior e Pleno.

  • Liderar a estratégia de QA, incluindo a avaliação e adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias, como IA/ML, para melhorar a eficiência e a cobertura dos testes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em engenharia de software na garantia de qualidade.

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de CI/CD (ex: GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions) e otimização de pipelines para testes automatizados .
  • Capacidade de liderar iniciativas de automação e influenciar decisões técnicas.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Mentalidade ágil , proativa e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades e projetos.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de testes como Zephyr .
  • Conhecimentos e habilidades para analisar o potencial de novas tecnologias, como IA/ML, e propor seu uso para resolver desafios complexos de qualidade de software.
  • Capacidade de avaliar e implementar soluções inovadoras que possam aumentar a velocidade de testes, como ferramentas de testes de API com IA.

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.

Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.

What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer

Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

title: Analista de Validação de Processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).

3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.

4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.

O que você pensa quando alguém diz que existe uma excelente oportunidade de trabalho em um banco?

Em alguns lugares pode até ser, mas aqui, no Banco Daycoval, existe um clima diferente!

Também temos uma importante missão com a sociedade! Por isso, promovemos campanhas solidárias e apoio direto, via doação ou lei de incentivo fiscal, para diversas instituições de renome.

Tudo isso torna possível a união entre a busca por resultados e o engajamento dos colaboradores com a sustentabilidade.

E não poderíamos deixar de falar que nós, do Daycoval, consideramos todos os talentos, independentemente de etnia, religião, cor, sexo, idade, condição de deficiência, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, ou qualquer outro motivo que caracterize discriminação pela legislação local.

title: Pessoa Vendedora
description:
Vaga: Pessoa Vendedora Sobre a Arrow

A Arrow é uma empresa de inovação e desenvolvimento de software especializada em soluções customizadas para empresas que buscam transformação digital. Operamos a partir do ACATE (Associação Catarinense de Tecnologia) no centro de Florianópolis , o principal hub de inovação e tecnologia de Santa Catarina, cercado por startups, scale-ups e empresas de tecnologia líderes do mercado.

Estamos em fase de crescimento acelerado e buscamos expandir nosso time comercial com profissionais que queiram crescer junto conosco.

Sobre a Vaga

Procuramos uma Pessoa Vendedora proativa, orientada a resultados e apaixonada por vendas para atuar em tempo integral, modelo híbrido em Florianópolis.

Como Vendedor, você será o primeiro ponto de contato com potenciais clientes, responsável por construir nosso pipeline comercial através de prospecção ativa, qualificação de leads e agendamento de reuniões estratégicas.

Esta é uma posição chave para quem quer:

  • Construir carreira em vendas B2B no setor de tecnologia
  • Aprender sobre desenvolvimento de software e transformação digital
  • Trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e meritocrático onde performance = reconhecimento

Responsabilidades

Prospecção Ativa (50% do tempo):

  • Identificar e mapear potenciais clientes através de pesquisa online, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Facebook, Instagram, Workana e outras ferramentas
  • Executar estratégias de cold calling, cold emailing e social selling
  • Participar de eventos de networking e representar a Arrow

Chamadas & Reuniões (30% do tempo):

  • Realizar chamadas de descoberta para entender necessidades e dores dos prospects
  • Avaliar fit entre perfil do cliente e soluções Arrow (BANT qualification)
  • Realizar chamadas de fechamento de vendas com os clientes

Gestão de Pipeline (20% do tempo):

  • Manter CRM atualizado com informações detalhadas de leads, interações e status
  • Executar follow-ups estratégicos com leads em nurturing
  • Reportar métricas semanais: leads adicionados, reuniões agendadas, taxa de conversão, pipeline gerado

Perfil Desejado

Essencial:

  • Experiência comercial: Mínimo 2 ano em vendas, prospecção ou atendimento B2B (SDR, BDR, inside sales ou similar)
  • Comunicação excepcional: Português fluente (verbal + escrita), habilidade de storytelling e construção de rapport
  • Proatividade e disciplina: Confortável com cold calling, rejeição e trabalho por metas
  • Organização: Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (Pipedrive, RD Station, HubSpot ou similar)
  • Residente ou disposto a se mudar para Florianópolis (modelo híbrido requer presença no escritório)

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no setor de tecnologia (SaaS, desenvolvimento de software, consultoria tech)
  • Domínio de ferramentas: Apollo, Workana, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lemlist
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de vendas: SPIN Selling, BANT, Challenger Sale
  • Formação superior em andamento ou completa (Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, Engenharia ou correlatas)
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (diferencial para atendimento de clientes internacionais)

Remuneração & Potencial de Ganhos

Modelo híbrido: Salário Base + Comissionamento por Performance

Remuneração total (base+bônus): R$ 4.000 - R$ 6.000/mês

Pacote de Benefícios Arrow

Na Arrow, cuidamos do bem-estar e desenvolvimento de cada profissional. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios através do nosso parceiro X-coop que vai além do salário (alguns serviços são contratados a parte pelo colaborador):

Saúde & Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de qualidade com ampla rede credenciada
  • Plano Odontológico: Cobertura nacional para você e sua família
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Acesso a rede nacional de academias, estúdios de yoga, pilates, crossfit e mais
  • Plataforma de Telemedicina: Consultas com nutricionistas, psicólogos, orientação contábil e mais — tudo com acesso com desconto
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção para você e sua família

Ambiente de Trabalho:

  • Escritório no ACATE Downtown: Trabalhe no principal hub de inovação de Florianópolis, com networking diário com startups e empresas tech
  • Café, snacks e estrutura completa: Espaço colaborativo com salas de reunião, áreas de descompressão e eventos regulares
  • Modelo híbrido flexível: Trabalhe 2-3 dias/semana no escritório, 2-3 dias remotos (flexibilidade após período de onboarding)

Condições de Trabalho

  • Formato: Híbrido (2-3 dias/semana no escritório ACATE Downtown + 2-3 dias remotos)
  • Localização: Florianópolis/SC (Centro - ACATE)
  • Jornada: Segunda a sexta, 8h/dia (horário comercial flexível)
  • Contrato: Cooperado
  • Início: Imediato (onboarding de 2 semanas com treinamento intensivo)

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position ( CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.

About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.

  • Sell GTT’s international network services, including Global WAN, Ethernet, Direct Internet Access, IP Transit, SD-WAN, and MPLS.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through development to close, ensuring timely execution and deal completion.
  • Collaborate with marketing and internal teams to maximize prospecting initiatives and accelerate pipeline growth.

Required Experience/Qualifications:

The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of the LATAM wholesale carrier market, including the commercial landscape, pricing dynamics, and cross-border connectivity trends. Knowledge of major Tier 1 carriers and regional operators—such as Claro, Telefónica, América Móvil, and Millicom—is essential to identify opportunities and negotiate effectively. This expertise will enable the candidate to position GTT’s global network solutions competitively and drive strategic growth in the region.

  • 5–10+ years of experience in wholesale or reseller sales within the telecom or networking industry.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing deals with Tier 1 carriers, ISPs, and channel partners.
  • Strong knowledge of global WAN services, Ethernet, DIA, IP Transit, and related technologies.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies such as SPIN, Miller Heiman, or similar.
  • Ability to engage confidently with technical topics and articulate complex solutions clearly.
  • Experience selling SD-WAN and security solutions.
  • Established network of contacts within the carrier and reseller ecosystem.
  • Candidates must speak, English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Core Competencies:

  • Negotiating
  • Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Networking
  • Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive.
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations
  • Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling
  • Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer need.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing)
  • Knowledge of customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting customer value creation at every level. Builds relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Paid Acquisiton Specialist
description:
Job Title: Paid Acquisition Specialist

Company:

Our client is a fast-growing digital marketing agency supporting DTC e-commerce brands across beauty, fashion, food, and pet industries. They are seeking a skilled Paid Acquisition Specialist to build, optimize, and scale full-funnel acquisition systems across Meta, TikTok, and Google.

Work Schedule: 15-20 hours/week.

This role is for someone who understands performance marketing at a systems level—not just platform execution. You’ll work cross-functionally with creative, CRO, and retention teams to deliver profitable, integrated acquisition strategies. The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of client growth.

Key Responsibilities

Acquisition Systems & Funnel Optimization

  • Build and manage full-funnel paid acquisition strategies for multiple DTC brands.
  • Audit and rebuild funnels to improve CAC, ROAS, MER, and LTV-based payback windows.
  • Diagnose scaling issues and implement solutions that address root-cause problems.
  • Coordinate closely with CRO to reduce friction in landing pages and improve CVR.

Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Own audience strategy, testing frameworks, attribution models, and budget allocation.
  • Collaborate with the creative team to develop and iterate on high-converting angles, hooks, and formats.
  • Produce insights that push creative direction and accelerate performance.

Cross-Channel Alignment

  • Work with retention teams to ensure acquisition aligns with lifecycle metrics and profitability.
  • Integrate insights from creative, CRO, and analytics to strengthen message-market fit.
  • Contribute to unified growth strategies across all channels.

Affiliate & Non-Paid Testing

  • Explore and manage affiliate partnerships, creator programs, and non-paid acquisition channels where relevant.
  • Build complementary acquisition pathways beyond paid performance.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document all experiments, learnings, wins, and failures using internal templates.
  • Provide clear reporting focused on revenue-impacting metrics (ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV).
  • Suggest improvements to maintain system scalability and performance consistency.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid acquisition for DTC brands.
  • Strong expertise in Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads.
  • Proven ability to scale brands from <$50K/month to $200K+/month profitably.
  • Strong analytical and attribution skills (MER, blended ROAS, incrementality testing).
  • Experience collaborating with creative teams and providing data-backed direction.
  • Excellent communication, reliability, and documentation habits.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with beauty, fashion, food, or pet verticals.
  • Familiarity with CRO and landing page optimization.
  • Experience running or supporting affiliate/creator programs.
  • Understanding of creative strategy and testing methodologies.

Schedule

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Remote position with ongoing collaboration across cross-functional teams.

Payments are in USD or local currency.

title: Consultor de Vendas - Off Trade São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia , gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas Off-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais mercados e lojas da cidade.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, é preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente garantindo visibilidade e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes Off-Trade em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar o portfólio dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade e condições comerciais.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal Off-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Experience and knowledge of MES systems in Life Sciences industry (Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology and similar) - Knowledge/Background of WERUM PAS-X is a plus.
  • Brazilian Portuguese native language fluency.

Our first-in-class WERUM PAS-X software offering allows our customers to control and record the making of life saving therapies to ensure the best possible business and patient outcomes. We are seeking talented individuals as we look to transform our business and products to meet the constantly shifting demands of the ongoing revolution in factory digitization and automation.

  • Opportunities for personal development enabling attractive career paths as you work in interesting, challenging and varied projects.
  • You will have flexible working hours in the office or working from home.

Can you find yourself in this profile?

Then you are right at Körber. We are looking forward to getting to know you!

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.

Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data

Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Mall - Segurança
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Fazer a gestão de toda a equipe de segurança e time orgânico (supervisores cftv e bombeiros civis);
  • Assegurar toda estratégia da segurança patrimonial do shopping;
  • Fazer a gestão da brigada de incêndio (fiscalização de lojas, áreas técnicas e mall, atendimento a clientes, etc);
  • Garantir o registro e análise das ocorrências e situações de risco;
  • Gerir os contratos das empresas terceirizadas (segurança, brigada de incêndio, etc);

title: Senior Manager, Shared Services Center
description:
About the company:

COFCO International is a global agribusiness company that purchases, stores, sells, processes, and distributes essential agricultural commodities: grains, oilseeds, sugar, cotton, and coffee.

Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, COFCO International employs approximately 11,000 professionals in 37 countries and has assets on every continent, with operations in more than 50 countries.

COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.

About the position:

Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.

Main responsibilities:

Develop and implement effective strategies for the SSC, aligned with the objectives of each business;

Identify and implement continuous improvements in SSC processes and systems, with the aim of increasing efficiency and reducing costs;

Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;

Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;

Ensure the control of service contracts, leases, and similar agreements, from the receipt of the supply process to the termination of the contract;

Manage COFCO's financial control involving Accounts Payable and Receivable operations, ensuring write-offs and controls and advances made to suppliers, following established policies;

Responsible for ensuring all COFCO Freight and Transit operations, from contracting services to accurate entries and payments;

Responsible for seeking efficiency in SSC operations through SLAs agreed with each business leader;

Ensure the accounting reconciliation of COFCO INTL companies in Brazil, aiming to comply with accounting standards and in line with global Controllership guidelines;

Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;

Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;

Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;

Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;

More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;

Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;

Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;

Fluency in English;

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint);

Experience with the SAP system;

Experience with SLAs and KPIs;

Strong project and process management skills;

Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;

Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;

Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;

Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;

Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;

Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.

Please send your resume in English.

COFCO International is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified talent is welcome and considered for our positions, regardless of race or ethnicity, religious belief, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

To learn how COFCO International collects and processes your personal data during your job application, please refer to our Privacy Policy

title: Especialista em Tecnologia da Informação
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação.

Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up , o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Desafio

Garantir que a área de Tecnologia da Informação seja um diferencial estratégico para a operação de Celulose, promovendo inovação, eficiência, segurança e integração dos processos.

Atividades principais

  • Gerenciar projetos de inovação, digitalização e automação de processos industriais.
  • Atuar como referência técnica, orientando equipes locais e globais, promovendo boas práticas e disseminando conhecimento.
  • Garantir a conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e compliance.
  • Administrar contratos, custos e orçamentos da área de TI.
  • Realizar a gestão de softwares, licenças e integrações entre sistemas corporativos (SAP, Senior, BI, Portais, etc.).
  • Propor soluções de BI, analytics, bots, powerapps e outras tecnologias para otimizar a produção, gestão de recursos e tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver e validar planos de contingência, assegurando a disponibilidade dos sistemas críticos.

Qualificações requeridas

Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas

Desejável Especialização Tecnologia da Informação, Gestão de Projetos, Gestão Empresarial, Indústria 4.0, Produção de Celulose

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

title: Supervisor de Fábrica - Eletrificação e Montagem de Painéis Elétricos
description:
Supervisor de Fábrica – Eletrificação e Montagem de Painéis Elétricos

Resumo da Vaga

Buscamos um profissional experiente para liderar a implantação e a operação de uma nova fábrica dedicada à montagem, eletrificação e testes de retificadores industriais (NPT) e painéis de automação, proteção e controle (POWER Solutions). Será responsável por estruturar processos, treinar equipe, garantir padrões de qualidade e conduzir a produção do início ao fim.

Responsabilidades Principais

Implantação da Fábrica

Estruturar o layout da área produtiva, definindo fluxo de trabalho, etapas de montagem e logística interna.

Criar procedimentos operacionais (SOPs) para montagem, eletrificação e testes.

Definir lista de ferramentas, dispositivos, EPI/EPC e infraestrutura necessária.

Apoiar na seleção, compra e homologação de insumos e componentes elétricos.

Gestão da Produção

Coordenar a montagem eletromecânica de painéis elétricos, painéis de automação, quadros de controle, CCMs e retificadores.

Garantir execução conforme diagramas elétricos, listas de materiais e documentação técnica.

Acompanhar diariamente prazos, prioridades e carga de trabalho.

Realizar checklists de qualidade, testes elétricos, testes funcionais e FAT interno.

Liderança Técnica

Supervisionar técnicos e montadores, distribuindo atividades e avaliando performance.

Treinar equipe em boas práticas de montagem, segurança e qualidade.

Realizar auditorias internas para manter padrão de excelência.

Interface com Engenharia, Compras e Projetos

Trabalhar em conjunto com Engenharia para validar diagramas, listas de cabos e melhorias de processos.

Apoiar Compras na especificação técnica de materiais e fornecedores.

Reportar status da produção e eventuais desvios ao gestor de engenharia/comercial.

Qualidade, Segurança e Compliance

Garantir conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis (NR-10, NR-12, NBR IEC 61439, IEC 61850 de acordo com projeto, entre outras).

Implementar rotinas de inspeção, rastreabilidade e padronização de montagem.

Qualificações Necessárias

Experiência comprovada em supervisão de montagem de painéis elétricos ou fábricas de automação industrial.

Forte domínio em leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos (unifilar, trifilar, lógica e interligação).

Vivência com montagem e testes de:

painéis de comando, automação e proteção

quadros elétricos de baixa tensão

retificadores industriais, fontes CC ou sistemas de energia

Conhecimento prático em instrumentos de teste (megômetro, multímetro, terrômetro, fontes de teste etc.).

Conhecimento de normas NR-10 e NR-12.

Capacidade de liderança e gestão de equipe técnica.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com retificadores tiristorizados ou chaveados.

Vivência em painéis com relés de proteção, IEDs e automação de subestações.

Experiência prévia com implantação de linhas de produção.

Familiaridade com controle de estoque, Kanban ou métodos de produção enxuta.

Perfil Comportamental

Mão na massa, organizado e orientado a prazos.

Capacidade de estruturar processos do zero.

Liderança firme, didática e comprometida com qualidade.

  • Atenção a detalhes técnicos e disciplina operacional.

title: Research Drive Assistant (Fieldwork)
description:
Short term contract, Dec 1-23

Pulse Labs is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.

If you enjoy fieldwork, are comfortable riding in vehicles with research participants, and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute a unique qualitative research project on driver behavior. 

For this project, you will meet UX researchers and study participants designated locations in Sao Paulo and will ride in the participant's vehicle to provide technical support and general assistance to the UX researcher during the drives. You MUST be willing to do this to be considered for this role.

After the driving portion, from December 1-11, you will assist the researchers with data analysis and preparation of the final report for this project.

This is a Sao Paulo based contract position. Occasionally, you will be required to work after standard work hours, including weekends.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers for the project, and ride with the researcher in a participant's vehicle for 3-6 hours per day from December 1 to December 11.
  • After December 11, you will assist researchers with analysis and translation of data captured during the drives.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining cameras and other equipment, uploading video files, helping schedule drives with participants.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for the client
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, help create deliverables for the client including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.

  Basic Qualifications

  • 1-5 years of experience working as technical support, customer support or a research analyst in a research setting or at a tech company.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese with strong written and verbal communications in both.
  • Ability to talk to strangers, make them feel at ease, and quickly build a rapport.
  • Experience data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • High attention to detail and ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in data.
  • Collaborative attitude and ability to foster a positive work environment.
  • Very comfortable using emerging technologies and different software systems. 
  • High comfort working with Google Docs, Google Sheets, or similar products.
  • A positive, curious attitude and willingness to learn.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree in computer science, psychology, research methods, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field. 
  • Previous experience conducting research fieldwork for international clients.
  • Previous work with early-to-mid stage startups or top tech companies.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)

Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.

Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.

Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.

Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator

At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

title: Especialista de Recursos Humanos (Desenvolvimento Organizacional)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
